artifact.title: Proposed: an index of delivered artifacts
artifact.subtitle: A design that does not exist, drawn against the parts of the engine it would build on
artifact.summary: Nothing below is installed. The engine, its receipts and its delivery layer are real and are cited; the index, its store and its page are the proposal. An `artifact.summary` is permitted here for exactly that reason — this document is a design argument rather than a map of what runs, and saying so is the honest thing for its opening paragraph to do.

groups.label: What exists today
groups.summary: Each of these is in the repository at the commit named below, and each is cited.

groups.label: What is proposed
groups.summary: None of this exists. No citation is offered for any of it, because there is nothing to cite.

nodes.label: A producer skill
nodes.summary: Writes a specification and calls the engine. Two of them exist.

nodes.label: render-artifact
nodes.summary: Validates, renders, digests and commits atomically.

nodes.label: The receipt
nodes.summary: Names the renderer version and the digest and byte count of both the specification and the artifact.

nodes.label: A delivered artifact
nodes.summary: One self-contained HTML file, written by rename over its destination.

nodes.label: Receipt collector
nodes.summary: Would watch for receipts and record them. Does not exist.

nodes.label: The index store
nodes.summary: Would hold one row per delivered artifact. Does not exist.

nodes.label: The index page
nodes.summary: Would be a third artifact kind listing the other two. Does not exist, and would need a Feature decision before it could.

nodes.label: A reader
nodes.summary: Would open the index instead of hunting through directories.

paths.label: The proposed flow
paths.note: The first three edges happen today. The last four do not, and no citation is offered for them.

views.label: Only the cited parts
views.note: Everything in this view is in the repository at the declared commit.
